editorial:
Imagine working at a fancy beauty salon where the biggest drama is usually a bad haircut. That is the world Frankie Kelly lives in, until things get seriously weird. You will meet Frankie, a pageboy who just wants to do his job, and his sidekick Jefferson. The vibe is a fun mix of old-school mystery and light comedy, but the plot kicks off with a shock when a coworker is found dead in a dumbwaiter. Things get even more tense when Frankie's girlfriend, Mary, becomes the main suspect. You will find yourself rooting for Frankie as he tries to play detective to save the girl he loves from going to jail.

What really makes this work is the fast energy and the way it keeps you guessing. The acting is charming and doesn't feel too stiff, though some of the plot twists are a bit predictable if you have seen a lot of mysteries. The pacing is quick, so you will not get bored. If you enjoy these kinds of vintage whodunits, you should definitely look for a high-quality version. Try renting it on Apple TV or adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection to see all the great set details clearly.
endingExplained: The mystery wraps up when Frankie discovers that the blackmail ring was run by people closer to the salon than anyone thought. After a tense standoff, the real killer is revealed to be the one person everyone trusted. Frankie manages to find the missing evidence that proves Mary was innocent all along. The police swoop in to make the arrest, and Frankie finally gets to relax with his girlfriend now that the danger is gone.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic detective stories and funny sidekicks.
